name: WakuMusic
description: Discord music bot using a remote Lavalink node and MongoDB Atlas.

BOT_ADMIN_ID.description: Discord user ID allowed to use bot administration commands

BOT_ADMIN_GUILD_ID.description: Optional home guild ID for immediate deployment of admin commands

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string. Required because Heroku dyno storage is temporary.

LAVALINK_HOST.description: Hostname or IP reachable from Heroku, without http:// or https://

LAVALINK_SECURE.description: Set true only when the Lavalink endpoint itself uses HTTPS/WSS

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Heroku app name. Required only to let /reload deploy the latest GitHub branch automatically.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku Account API key. Required only to let /reload create an automatic build and release.

HEROKU_REPOSITORY.description: Public GitHub repository in owner/repo format for automatic /reload deployment.
